results.title: Database stops for ~10 s: people see a plain message (no technical text), the app stays up, and recovers by itself
results.detail: outage handled (signed-in /home: 500 in 2552 ms; signed-in /requests: 500 in 2553 ms; sign-in page: 200 in 3 ms; health: 503); back to normal 7 s after restart, no app restart

results.title: The data gateway (PostgREST) stops: same expectations
results.detail: outage handled (signed-in /home: 500 in 22568 ms; signed-in /requests: 500 in 2548 ms; sign-in page: 200 in 2 ms; health: 503); back to normal 5 s after restart, no app restart

results.title: The sign-in service (GoTrue) stops: people already signed in keep working; sign-in says so plainly; recovers
results.detail: outage handled (signed-in /home: 200 in 57 ms; signed-in /requests: 200 in 51 ms; sign-in page: 200 in 2 ms; health: 200; already-signed-in /home still 200); back to normal 0 s after restart, no app restart

results.title: File storage stops: opening an attachment gives a clear "temporarily unavailable" (503), not a wrong "not found"; recovers
results.detail: 503 after 20 s (the 20 s wait to the storage service is by design); back after 2 s

results.title: A scheduled rule whose "claim" was written but whose actions never ran (simulated crash) is NOT retried: reports the at-most-once behaviour and how it would be noticed
results.detail: normal ticket escalated; crashed-claim ticket was NOT escalated and nothing reports it (silent loss window of the claim-first design, at-most-once)

results.title: Scheduler run is safe to repeat after an interruption: running it again right away changes nothing for already-handled tickets
Scheduler is refused without its secret even while the database is busy; and an interrupted request (client gives up after 50 ms) does not leave the app unhealthy
results.detail: 401 without secret; 6 abandoned scheduler calls, app healthy and same process
